hook.name: ModularLaunchpadHook
hook.description: A configurable Uniswap v4 launchpad hook that gates pool initialization to a factory and routes launch token swap fees into a 70/30 creator/protocol split. Deployed in "universal" economics mode: the hook holds the seed LP position and fees are collected via a permissionless harvest() call rather than afterSwap. Optional modules (anti-snipe buy caps, JIT defense, buy throttle, creator-fee burn, liquidity deepening) are baked in at deploy time as immutable config.
